ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_advantage_gap_logsigmoid_weighted_zscore_norm_clip
ir.intuition: Inject z-score normalization on the advantage_gap to enforce zero-mean unit-variance constraint, combined with symmetric clipping on the scaled log probability difference. This normalization removes bias and scale variance in the signal, promoting stable and normalized gradients while preserving pairwise margin structure.
ir.pseudocode:
mean_adv = mean(advantage_gap)
std_adv = max(std(advantage_gap), epsilon)
adv_norm = (advantage_gap - mean_adv) / std_adv
x_raw = alpha * scale * (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) / norm(adv_norm)
x_clipped = clamp(x_raw, -clip_value, clip_value)
loss = -logsigmoid(x_clipped)
if weight:
  loss = loss * weight
final_loss = mean(loss)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', None)
    advantage_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 1.9496803035382082))
    clip_value = float(extra.get('clip_value', 10.0))
    epsilon = 1e-6
    mean_adv = ops.mean(advantage_gap)
    centered_adv = ops.sub(advantage_gap, mean_adv)
    # Compute std dev as norm over sqrt(dim) for vector std
    dim = advantage_gap.shape[-1] if len(advantage_gap.shape) > 1 else 1
    var_adv = ops.div(ops.norm(centered_adv), ops.sqrt(ops.max(ops.sub(ops.norm(centered_adv), 0), ops.ones_like(centered_adv)[0]*dim)))
    std_adv = ops.maximum(var_adv, epsilon)
    adv_norm = ops.div(centered_adv, std_adv)
    norm_adv_norm = ops.maximum(ops.norm(adv_norm), epsilon)
    x_raw = ops.mul(alpha * scale, ops.div(ops.sub(lpw, lpl), norm_adv_norm))
    x_clipped = ops.clamp(x_raw, -clip_value, clip_value)
    loss = -ops.logsigmoid(x_clipped)
    if weight is not None:
        loss = loss * weight
    return ops.mean(loss)
